name: Emotions
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality and variety of human emotions, emphasizing the importance of managing them wisely. Believers are encouraged to be strong and courageous, trusting in God's presence to overcome fear and discouragement, as seen in Joshua 1:9. Proverbs highlights the impact of emotions on our spirit and relationships, warning against uncontrolled anger and advocating for self-control, comparing a lack of mastery over one's spirit to a defenseless city (Proverbs 15:18; 25:28). Ecclesiastes reminds us that there is an appropriate time for all emotions, encouraging discernment in their expression. Together, these verses teach that controlling and managing our emotions is vital for godly living and reflects the wisdom of a heart surrendered to God.
